# Pixel Shroom Studio

> Pixel Shroom Studio is the online art studio and gallery of LWVader (LWVADER), featuring numbered digital tier editions with individually identified files and signed receipts, direct-file artwork where listed, and selected designs on canvas, apparel and gifts.

Purchases are nonexclusive unless a listing explicitly states otherwise. Signing verifies source and file integrity, not exclusive ownership.

The canonical website is https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/. Digital artwork and physical products are separate offerings. Physical products are mapped to Gelato product UIDs. The studio collects delivery details, requests a quote, takes payment through Stripe and submits a dedicated print-ready file to Gelato for fulfillment. The initial integration supports US delivery in USD. Visitors can request any artwork listed on the studio website for apparel or canvas prints through the contact form; available options and pricing are discussed individually.

Use the linked pages for current listings, purchase details and usage rights. Availability can change. Public gallery images are previews, not unrestricted original downloads. A serial or verification result does not by itself establish copyright ownership, NFT ownership or eligibility for commercial use. Consult the published usage rights and listing details.

## Secondary editions

- [Secondary marketplace](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/market.html): Member-listed numbered editions, when open. Transfers change the studio-recorded holder, not copyright or exclusive rights. Existing downloads cannot be recalled. Seller proceeds use Stripe Connect; the platform fee is 10%, with Stripe processing fees paid by the platform. No resale value or returns are promised.

## Numbered digital editions

New collections have six finished studio-uploaded tier images: Standard, Silver, Gold, Emerald, Sapphire and Prismatic. Listed initial odds, supply and tier caps apply; effective probabilities change when tiers are exhausted. A buyer chooses an artwork, signs in and pays through Stripe. The server verifies payment, securely assigns a tier and atomically reserves a prepared copy. The concealed reveal starts after verified payment, keeps moving through preparation and private image loading, then slows into the result. It presents the server result and never chooses or rerolls the tier.

The issued PNG, JPEG or WebP copy has its own precomputed file fingerprint and signed receipt. Identity metadata makes authorized copies byte-distinct while preserving the uploaded tier image's visible pixels. The private master is not delivered. A limited edition is not exclusive ownership of the design and is not a blockchain token. Direct-file listings retain their stated delivery and verification method; older collections retain their applicable rules.

After reveal, Add to my collection saves the edition to the authenticated account and requests both image and signed JSON receipt downloads. Browsers may ask permission for multiple downloads. Retries retain the same assigned copy; closing the page does not reroll it. Keep the confirmation link and use My collection for purchase recovery when available.

- [My collection](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/collection.html): Account access, purchase recovery, saved editions and eligible seller setup. Private account content is not a public catalog.
- [Verify an edition](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/verify-mint.html): Local image hash and signed-receipt verification; files are not uploaded for verification. A successful check does not establish current ownership or resale value.
- [Verify a direct-file original](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/verify.html): Earlier original-file verification using an LWV serial.

- [Physical orders](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/print-orders.html): Private account page for print-order payment and fulfillment status; physical purchases do not include digital downloads or numbered editions.

## Forge & Print storefront preview

- [The Forge](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/forge.html): planned same-artwork trade-up recipes; calculator only, no live burn transactions.
- [Drop odds](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/drop-odds.html): base six-tier rates and proposed bundle guarantees. Rolls are server-side, not on-chain.
- [Canvas specifications](https://www.pixelshroomstudio.com/canvas-specs.html): planned 16 × 16 unframed and 16 × 20 portrait framed products, US only.
- Planned offers: digital roll $8; canvas roll $69 + $13.49 prepaid shipping, before applicable tax. New checkout paths, guarantees and Forge are not yet open.
- Current listings retain their own available prices and delivery terms. A signed receipt verifies source/integrity and does not grant exclusivity.
